title: MATKP Differential Gene Expression Browser
bodyHtml:
Explore interactive visualizations of differential gene expression within human or mouse adipose tissue. Differential expression analyses were performed on bulk RNA sequencing datasets or single-cell RNA sequencing-derived pseudobulk datasets. For a selected dataset and comparison, visualize an interactive heatmap of the top 20 differentially expressed genes and interactive volcano plot of all differentially expressed genes. Hover for more information about each differentially expressed gene, and click to view details in the table below. Click on a gene on the heatmap to see it in the volcano plot.

View differential expression results for all genes in the table below. Type a gene name to search. Click "Show" in the Gene query column to obtain interactive violin plots and scatterplots.

If you use data from this page, please review our Citation Policies to ensure proper citation of the underlying resource(s) used to generate these analyses.

Explore MATKP to learn more about adipose tissue-relevant datasets, phenotypes, or gene information, cell type expression in various conditions. Contribute to the growing body of adipose-related knowledge by submitting your data to the MATKP here.
